title: Forge realms map v1
description: The world an invocation opens (decision 0023, phase 1): the repositories a run may see, and the journal that world writes. A repository is a realm; the map is the connective truth and is not itself a realm. Minimal by ruling: the realms and the journal, nothing else. Decision 0021's per-realm driver and egress constraints are a LATER version, deliberately not speculatively schema'd here, and the loader refuses unknown fields — so a v2 addition arrives as a version, never as drift in a file that still calls itself v1.

realms.description: One entry per repository. A single-project workspace is the degenerate map with one entry, and pays nothing for the shape.

name.description: The realm's identity, and the key every per-realm fact is recorded under in the journal — the shape the heritage protocol recorded as 'repository name to observed HEAD'. Unique within a map.

path.description: The realm's working tree: absolute, or relative to the directory the map file itself lives in, so a map is portable with the workspace it describes.

default_branch.description: The branch this realm's work is measured against. Recorded and read out; this version acts on nothing else.

journal.description: The world's workspace database: absolute, or relative to the map file's own directory. `--db` is retained and OUTRANKS this, and with neither map nor `--db` the default journal path is exactly what it always was.
